scientific_integrity: Earliest verified public source is the University of Rhode Island open-access 2017 dissertation (repository downloads since 2017-04-26), not its 2019 journal version. New proof has exact derivations and a standalone checker; the published global convergence theorem is attributed. No independent audit or guarantee of publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The exact heteroclinic closed form is confined to the unique invariant straight segment, on a codimension-one parameter resonance. Whole-positive-quadrant convergence comes from the 2019 originating paper, not the new calculation. The universal quadratic-log rate applies to initial points off that segment and to distance to the segment, not to the endpoint equilibrium; other parameter regions are not classified here. Unindexed equivalent work has not been excluded.
title: An exact heteroclinic resonance and quadratic-log transverse contraction in a Leslie–Gower map
